payload.text: THE 3.5.0 CUT, FIRED AND THE TAP MOVED (hv, 2026-11-21, first-hand in vc's session by question dialogs read between 14:05Z and 14:36Z on vc's date -u, the questions' wording vc's, the choices hv's; and hv's own words in prose). (1) "Fire with --yes (Recommended)": the cut ran as PATH="$PWD/native/rust/target/release:$PATH" bin/devbin release v3.5.0 --yes, the 3.5.0 pair first because vc's 14:01Z pre-flight had migrated main's store to schema 37 (a breach of decision 132, vc's error; dc showed any schema-moving cut migrates it at preflight and stamp). (2) "vc runs the reset (Recommended)": the first run stopped at legs before any tag because Xcode 27.2 rewrote Intent.xcscheme; vc ran git reset --keep a0f1943f8 (the release commit was local only), committed the scheme at 39f6f1683, and re-cut: v3.5.0 at 940c9535a, tag e06de1b3c, every leg green, released 14:34Z. (3) "Move the tap after the push (Recommended)", then in prose "I approve you doing it n": bin/devbin cut tap ran at 14:36Z with DEVBIN_RELEASE_CONFIRMED=v3.5.0, formula published, smoke green. (4) In prose: "You can upgrade whatever needs upgrading." and "And get gyges and Kovacs to do the same.": Intent's own project upgraded at 0ab6485e4 and pushed; kovacs on 3.5.0; gyges held on its own classifier, for hv.
